name: Mi Dai
title: Research Assistant Professor
bio: LINCC Frameworks project scientist; co-leads the LightCurveLynx project; experienced user of LSDB and Hyrax; SOC member for the first LINCC Frameworks hackathon; co-convener of the DESC Time-Domain working group.

name: Rebecca Chen
bio: Extensive experience simulating transient surveys with the SNANA/PIPPIN pipeline ecosystem; experienced user of RAIL for photometric redshift estimation; served on multiple LOCs and SOCs for DESC and DES collaboration meetings.

name: Matthew Grayling
bio: Co-convener of the DESC Time-Domain working group; leads integration of the BayeSN SED model within DESC infrastructure.

name: Jason (Jaemyoung) Lee
bio: Developing a SN Ia host-galaxy property estimation pipeline and a scene-modeling photometry (SMP) code; leads a SMP challenge in the DESC Pixels to Light Curves working group.
